text_block_list.text:
While out shopping, I notice Найс Нэйчер
and
Матиканэтангейзер out with a
young
Umamusume girl.
What about these shoes, kiddo?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Oooh! Yeah, I'll take those! Thanks,
Nature!
text_block_list.name: Energetic Young Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
Awww! They look so cute and easy to
run in! ♪
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text:
I'm glad you like them. If you're happy,
I'm happy.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list: Out shopping with your little sister?

text_block_list.text:
Hm? Oh, nothing like that! I got to know
this
kiddo during my volunteer activities.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
She asked us to help her pick out some
shoes!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text: Ehehe! Next time, with these shoes, I'm definitely gonna win!
text_block_list.name: Energetic Young Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
Ohooo, look at you getting all fired up.
That's
kids these days for ya. Brimming
with energy!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
That's right! And sometimes you get
fired up too,
right, Nature?
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text:
Nahhh, definitely not. If anything, I get
humbled
before I even have the chance
to get fired up...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Phew... Individual training complete and
my legs
are feeling great. All that's left
is to actually win.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Argh! I tied with you again, McQueen?! Quit latching onto me!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: Excuse me?! The sentiment is mutual! I was supposed to seize victory by a huge margin!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... I couldn't... even... line up... alongside... them...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
...Hahaha. Guess that's all I can manage,
no
matter how hard I try...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
And that's how I got humbled... Probably
not
somethin' young folks like you can
relate to, huh?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
That's not true... I can definitely relate. I
mean...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text: You're my Teio and my McQueen!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text: ...What?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'm just your average
Umamusume... A lot
of the time, I don't
even place in races.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text: But you! You're always placing in the top five! That consistency is amazing! I want to be just like you!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text: Tannhauser...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Oh! But if you're going to be down on
yourself, I
can use this chance to finally
catch up to you!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, this is our chance! We're gonna
surpass
you, Nature!
text_block_list.name: Energetic Young Umamusume

text_block_list.text: ...Heh.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Ahahah! Hehehe! It's been ages since I
laughed
that hard.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Who'd have thought little old me could
get you
two fired up? Looks like hope's
not lost on the
young'uns yet!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I guess that really does mean I've
gotta
stay on my toes.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I guess that really does mean I've
gotta
stay on my toes.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Ack... W-well, I suppose I am still
somethin' of a
rookie myself...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
All right! I'm all fired up and burning
with passion!
I won't lose to you, Nature!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, watch out, Nature! We're coming
for you!
Wooo!
text_block_list.name: Energetic Young Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
S-stop! Stop, what if someone hears
you?! Talk
about embarrassing.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Sigh... How do Teio and McQueen stay so calm when people say all those cheesy things? They even have comebacks!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Uh... so what, you gonna pour everything
you've
got into giving guidance or
something?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Oooh! A strong opponent has emerged! Now we've really gotta focus!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text:
Yeesh... Personally, I'd prefer it if my
"strong
opponents" would ease up on
the pressure a
little...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
But ah well... I guess I'll get some new
shoes too.
I've gotta be prepared for any
up-and-coming
challengers, after all.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I think I need to prepare myself mentally
before I
even think about challenging
them...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
